title: States of uncertainty
summary: Community solar in the United States has endured several big changes in the past year, not least the termination of the Solar for All program, the introduction of domestic content requirements, the removal of tax credits, and the enactment of the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA). The termination of Solar for All in 2025 resulted in the sudden loss of $7 billion in solar development funding, including for community solar, dealing a hard blow to the sector.
